concerns.description: Flattened sub-lists: 22 item(s) contain nested sub-items (a/b/c or bullets) as plain text instead of structured children
concerns.analysis: flattened_sublists=22. Examples: p44 table: • HDMI® supports up to 4096x2160@60Hz, • USB-C® supports up to 5120x2880@60Hz; p46 table: • HDMI® supports up to 4096x2160@60Hz, • USB-C® supports up to 5120x2880@60Hz; p48 table: • HDMI® supports up to 4096x2160@60Hz, • USB-C® supports up to 5120x2880@60Hz. Sub-items embedded as newline-delimited text lose semantic nesting in HTML — screen readers can't navigate the hierarchy.
